new_today_news.headline: Water State Revolving Funds Continue Distributing $23.4 Billion in Combined Clean Water and Drinking Water Funding
new_today_news.summary: IIJA core formula programs for water infrastructure remain intact through September 2026. Water State Revolving Funds continue distributing $23.4 billion in combined clean water and drinking water funding, with authorization expiring September 30, 2026.

new_today_news.headline: How Summer Heat Affects Restaurant Grease Traps
new_today_news.summary: Examines operational and environmental impacts of seasonal temperature variations on grease trap performance and maintenance scheduling in restaurants during peak summer season.

recent_news.headline: WM Updates Recycle Right® Rules: No Batteries in Recycling or Trash
recent_news.summary: WM announced updates to its Recycle Right® program, adding batteries to its list of items that should never go in recycling or trash bins due to fire risk. The announcement emphasizes fire safety across waste and recycling facilities.

recent_news.headline: Chain Restaurant Closures and Consolidation Continue to Shape Industry Landscape
recent_news.summary: Major U.S. restaurant chains including Wendy's, Starbucks, and others are closing hundreds of locations in 2026 due to weak sales and rising costs. These closures have implications for service providers in waste management and grease collection, as underperforming and closed locations eliminate demand for maintenance services.
